summary: PR #1252 (cloud/ad3-1-fingerprint-folds) was built in the cloud window on 2026-11-03/04 and fell 400+ commits behind main. It was closed unmerged. Its description: ## Summary AD3-1 of the D3 decisions (`docs/plans/architecture-decisions-2026-11.md`, PR #1247). `normalizeReasonForFingerprint` in `go/internal/core/failure_digest.go` now folds three per-cycle tokens: - `cycle=2071` becomes `cycle=N` (word-bounded, so `recycle=12` stays). - `cycle-2049-<26-char Crockford ULID>` becomes `cycle-N-<ulid>`. This fold runs before the existing cycle-number fold, which had read only the first ULID digits (`cycle-2049-01m5…` became `cycle-Nm5…`, so the rest of the ULID stayed in the fingerprint). - `N finding(s)` / `N findings` / `N finding` becomes `<n> …`. A `N deterministic check failure(s)` count stays the same, because a different count can mean a different s
